description: Takes back the last publish of one event website the person organizes: the version published before it goes live again or, when there is none, the site goes offline. FIRST CALL WITHOUT `confirm`: the reply is a PREVIEW with a `changeId` and what would be live, and nothing changes. Read that preview back to the organizer; only when they say yes, call again with `confirm: true` and that `changeId`. The draft is not touched. Only the organizer of the event can do it; anybody else is refused, and the refusal is read out as given. It requires a personal connector token.

changeId.description: The id of a previewed change; required when confirm is true.

confirm.description: True applies a previewed change; absent, the change is only previewed and nothing changes.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or the event name as the organizer spells it.

siteId.description: The site's id as site_list gives it.

name: site_undo_publish
title: Undo an event website's last publish (organizers only)
